in_sanskrit.name: प्रभकर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who illuminates like the moon

in_marathi.name: Prabhakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabhakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prabhakar is a Sanskrit name that means 'shining forth with the light of knowledge'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prabh' meaning 'shining forth' and 'kara' meaning 'doer'. This name is associated with the god Prabhakar, who is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom.
